entry.title: New: Reso 24-91 (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"ADOPTING MAUI WILDFIRES FIRE DEBRIS REMOVAL ALTERNATIVE PROGRAM STANDARDS" The purpose of this resolution is to establish the deadline to complete debris removal and to adopt the minimum standards applicable to fire debris removal conducted under the Alternative Program established pursuant to Ordinance 5562.
